summary: Iridium Communications filed an 8-K updating its pending acquisition by Rocket Lab Corporation under a June 28, 2026 merger agreement. Iridium's special meeting is set for September 24, 2026, with holders of record as of August 21 eligible to vote; the company expects to close the two-step merger in mid-2027. The registrant is the target, becoming an indirect wholly owned Rocket Lab subsidiary. Three New York state stockholder suits allege proxy disclosure deficiencies and seek to enjoin the deal, adding a supplemental-disclosure overhang to the merger timeline.
